snippet.title: SourceWorld Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on June 6 this year. The Demo version makes it's return after 9 months since its 2024 ModDB release. Featuring many overhauls of its older mechanics and introducing bunch of new ones, including the entirely reconstructed procedural map generator.

Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489490

ModDB: https://www.moddb.com/mods/sourceworld

Music:
TheAR3Guy - Starting Now
TheAR3Guy - Mayhem
